# SqlCompletionEngine

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Query.Intellisense.SqlCompletionEngine`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Query`

## Summary

Produces completion items for SQL IntelliSense by combining ScriptDom-based cursor context analysis with Dataverse metadata from PPDS.Dataverse.Metadata.ICachedMetadataProvider.
